Name: Tamar, Sister of David's Sons
Summary: Sister of David's sons, named after the list of David's sons.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:9: Sister of David's sons, named after the list of David's sons.
LifeLesson: The mention of Tamar in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
